## C. User-owned media server

<a id="jellyfin"></a>
### Jellyfin (user's own server) — READY

- **URL:** https://jellyfin.org/
- **Languages:** all; **NSFW:** no
- **Content:** The user's own media library on a self-hosted Jellyfin server
- **Integration:** Documented REST API with token authentication ([docs](https://api.jellyfin.org/))
- **Permission / licensing:** Users access their own server with their own account; the API is the official client interface.
- **Technical:** Login via POST /Users/AuthenticateByName, catalog via /Items, episodes via /Shows/{id}/Episodes, direct play via /Videos/{id}/stream?static=true, text subtitles via /Videos/{id}/{source}/Subtitles/{index}/0/Stream.srt.
- **Module:** `src/all/jellyfin`
- **Last verified:** 2026-10-20
- **Evidence:**
  - All endpoints used were exercised on a local Jellyfin 12.2.0 server (official Linux build) with a public-domain film and a synthetic test series.
  - Accept: application/json yields PascalCase JSON; a wildcard Accept yields camelCase (verified).
  - LiveServerTest (login, catalog, details, episodes, ranged stream with header auth, subtitle download) passed against that server.
  - The aniyomi-extensions-inspector v1.5.0.2 instantiated the release APK: id 1100359934660540567, baseUrl ''.
- **Restrictions:**
  - No transcoding requested; the player must support the original codec.
  - Image-based subtitles are not offered.
  - Seasons are flattened into one episode list.
- **Next action:** Install the APK in Anikku and test against a real library; consider lib-16 seasons and a multi-server factory.

## D. Public-domain / openly licensed collection

<a id="internetarchive"></a>
### Internet Archive — READY

- **URL:** https://archive.org/details/animationandcartoons
- **Languages:** all; **NSFW:** no
- **Content:** Animation & Cartoons collections: public-domain and openly licensed films plus community uploads
- **Integration:** Public Advanced Search and Metadata APIs ([docs](https://archive.org/developers/))
- **Permission / licensing:** Public API; access-restricted (lending) items and private files are excluded. Each item declares its own rights.
- **Technical:** advancedsearch.php for catalog/search, /metadata/{id} for details, episodes and video files, /download/ for media.
- **Module:** `src/all/internetarchive`
- **Last verified:** 2026-10-20
- **Evidence:**
  - Fixture tests on recorded responses and an opt-in live test (search, metadata, HEAD on a resolved video URL) passed.
  - Inspector reported id 1829328537302010998, baseUrl https://archive.org.
  - Deep paging is limited to 10,000 results ([DEEP_PAGING] error verified).
- **Restrictions:**
  - Rights are as declared by uploaders; 'latest' includes community uploads.
  - No language filter (language metadata too sparse).
- **Next action:** On-device test; consider more curated collections.

<a id="wikimedia-commons"></a>
### Wikimedia Commons — REVIEW_REQUIRED

- **URL:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/
- **Languages:** all; **NSFW:** no
- **Content:** Freely licensed and public-domain media, including animated films
- **Integration:** MediaWiki Action API (categorymembers + imageinfo/extmetadata) ([docs](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page))
- **Permission / licensing:** Content is freely licensed per file; the API is public, subject to Wikimedia's API rate-limit policy.
- **Technical:** Video files (WebM/Ogg) are served directly from upload.wikimedia.org; licenses are available per file via extmetadata.
- **Module:** none
- **Last verified:** 2026-10-20
- **Evidence:**
  - The first categorymembers request on Category:Animated_films returned files, with a continuation token.
  - Further requests returned HTTP 429 'You are making too many requests to the API' from this environment's shared IP, pointing to https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs/Rate_limits.
- **Restrictions:**
  - Rate limits apply per IP/User-Agent; a descriptive User-Agent is required by Wikimedia policy.
- **Next action:** From a network that is not rate-limited, record fixtures, confirm that category membership plus per-file license filtering yields a useful catalog, then implement.
